Network.Happened: The fetch failed before reaching Chronicle: {error}.
Network.Cause: Foundry could not reach Chronicle at all — typically a DNS, TLS, CORS, or firewall problem.
Network.Action: Verify your Chronicle address in Chronicle Sync's Settings, then open the install URL in a browser to confirm it is reachable from this host.

Parse.Happened: Chronicle's response could not be parsed as a module manifest: {error}.
Parse.Cause: Chronicle returned a response but the body is not a valid module manifest. This is unusual when Chronicle is healthy.
Parse.Action: Open the install URL in a browser. If you see HTML or an unexpected body, contact the Chronicle admin.
Parse.MissingFieldError: 200 OK but the response had no '{field}' field

HttpFallback.Happened: Chronicle responded with HTTP {status} {statusText} but did not return a structured error body.
HttpFallback.Cause: Something between Foundry and Chronicle (proxy, CDN, load balancer) returned the error, or Chronicle returned a non-JSON body.
HttpFallback.Action: Open the install URL in a browser to see the raw response. If it looks like a proxy error page, check your network. Otherwise contact the Chronicle admin.

NoUrl.Tried: No fetch — Foundry has no install-time manifest URL recorded for this module.
NoUrl.Happened: There is nothing to check; the module was not installed via a manifest URL.
NoUrl.Cause: Either Foundry installed this module from a local zip (drag-and-drop) or the install URL was stripped from the module record.
NoUrl.Action: Reinstall the module using your campaign's install URL from Chronicle's VTT Setup Guides so Foundry can record it for future update checks.

AuthFailure.Message: Your install URL is no longer valid. Copy the current Module Install URL from Chronicle's Campaign Settings → Integrations and reinstall this module to recover.
